Mark O. Wilson

About the author

Mark O. Wilson joined the religion faculty of Southern Wesleyan University in 2017 after serving for 26 years as senior pastor of Hayward Wesleyan Church in the northwoods of Wisconsin. He holds a doctorate (DMin in Transformational Preaching) from Wesley Seminary. Mark is the author of two books and his writings have appeared in several publications including Leadership Journal, Rev! Magazine and Pastors.com. He and his wife, Cathy, have five grown children.
